latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor ZH — fast AI-powered editing for Chinese video creators.

- Upload raw Chinese video (up to 500MB), request edits in Chinese, and export 1080p MP4 results.
- Fully cloud-based workflow: handles editing, subtitles, transitions, and background music via API.
- Automatic setup with free token provisioning and session management.
- Supports mp4, mov, avi, webm, and key audio/image formats.
- Error handling includes guidance for file limits, authentication, and export eligibility.
- Optimized for rapid, iterative editing and fast turnaround for shorter videos.
